prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic 3:4 nighttime forest portrait of an adult woman with fair natural skin, long voluminous wavy dark-brown hair, subtle winged eyeliner, long lashes, nude-pink lips, and a calm direct neutral gaze. She crouches on the autumn forest ground with knees drawn up, surrounded by dark leaves and trees. She wears a black floral-lace fashion top and a black velvet skirt. Use soft moonlight rim light on hair and face, low-key forest ambience, detailed lace texture and hair strands, a warm vintage cast, and visible 35mm film grain. Keep the mood calm and neutral, without sexualized expression or pose.
